name: We Energies Ixonia Lateral

values.OtherEnglishNames: We Energies Ixonia Lateral; Guardian Lateral

researcher_notes: Not in the roster. The Guardian Gas Pipeline row P0195 ends at Ixonia and no row covers this lateral. A 2001 trade press item on the Public Service Commission of Wisconsin vote describes a 35-mile Wisconsin Gas Lateral from the Guardian end near Ixonia to Germantown and Brookfield, owned by Wisconsin Gas (now marketed as We Energies). The surveying firm GRAEF project page says the 34-mile lateral took four years to complete, so status is operating by inference; no in-service date was found. Dates in the press items conflict (construction spring 2002 in one, spring 2003 in a Guardian item), so no start year is staged. Length is staged as 34 miles from the completion page; the approval figure was 35. Diameter and capacity were not found. Owner legal form not confirmed; spelled as the source spells it. Route not researched; the state regulator filing may hold official route maps. Both sources are the same project but different publishers, though neither is a regulator document, so tier is medium.
